title: Oncologic Timely Palliative Care And Remote Monitoring With Electronic Assessments And Telehealth (ON-TARGET)
official: Oncologic Timely Palliative Care And Remote Monitoring With Electronic Assessments And Telehealth (ON-TARGET)
summary: To examine how we can provide supportive care for patients with advanced cancer better tailored to their needs
criteria:
Eligibility Criteria

* Age ≥ 18
* Outpatients who are within 12 weeks of diagnosis of metastatic solid tumors and seen by one of the participating medical oncologists
* Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group Performance Status 0.2
* Able to speak English or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

. Cognitive impairment in the opinion of the oncologist necessitating need for a surrogate decision making.

• Previously seen by SPC team at UT MD Anderson
